plan.notes: Source: UGA Bulletin 2026-2027, A.B. in Criminal Justice (Franklin College of Arts and Sciences), four-year Program of Study (https://bulletin.uga.edu/Program/Details/64585?IDc=ARTS). Plan transcribed 2026-09-30 from the program page's semester-by-semester plan. Course credits and prerequisites verified against bulletin Course/Details pages. The four-year plan as published sums to 121 hours (including the 1-hr PEDB course). Area III Quantitative Reasoning footnote: choose from MATH 2200, MATH 2250, or STAT 2000. Criminal Justice Internship courses POLS 5500/5510/5520 use the program's listed standard 5 hours each. Prerequisites shown are the catalog options satisfiable within this plan's sequence, including options available via the plan's choose-one core blocks.
